Jordan (AE): CascadeBank approved a 21-day POC. Requirements: Okta SAML, SCIM provisioning with group->role mapping, domain-locked tenant, 1y audit retention ask. Need technical, security, and pricing sign-off.
Alisa (SE): Hosted domain-lock via DNS TXT OK. SAML with signed assertions + cert rotation supported. SCIM supports group membership->role mapping; delta syncs usually within 30-90s. Provisioning rate default 20 req/s.
Sam W: They will use Okta groups as source of truth: example mapping NB-Admins -> Admin. Also want example SAML attribute name.
Prashant (Security): We store SCIM creds encrypted in KMS by default; customer-managed KMS available for Dedicated. We can offer 365d audit retention for the POC as a one-off with addendum. Note: log export to their S3 requires enterprise add-on.
Marie (PS): Draft runbook: day0 exchange metadata.xml + DNS TXT; day1 SCIM initial sync; day2 smoke tests: login, create/update, role mapping; day3 acceptance. Acceptance criteria: SSO login for 3 admins, SCIM create/update for 20 users, role mapping validated, audit logs visible.
Jordan (AE): Pricing: offer 30% credits for POC. Post-POC options: continue hosted (usage-based) or upgrade to Dedicated with commit. I'll send quote and addendum before kickoff.
Alisa (SE): Share this SAML snippet with their Okta admin:
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="urn:cascade:role">
    <AttributeValue>Admin</AttributeValue>
  </AttributeStatement>
```
Sam W: Uploaded SQ draft: https://redwood.co/internal/sq/cascade-poc — please add comments.
Jordan (AE): Scheduling kickoff Wed 10am PT with their IdP engineer. Marie please lead validation. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
